name: HarkinianPad
tagline: Ocarina of Time running natively on iOS and iPadOS
description: HarkinianPad packages the full Ship of Harkinian source port as a native iOS and iPadOS app: Ocarina of Time rebuilt with Metal rendering, customizable touch controls, Files-based ROM setup, and support for keyboards, pointing devices, and iOS game controllers. It renders through Metal, imports a user-provided supported Ocarina of Time ROM through Files, and includes a landscape touch controller that can be hidden whenever a physical controller is connected. The repository contains the mobile integration and reproducible build scripts — the compile never reads your ROM, and the app never downloads or bundles game data; you bring your own legally acquired ROM after installation. It has been signed, installed, and played on a physical 12.9-inch iPad Pro, with the source-available integration code kept deliberately ROM-free and audited by package scripts.
highlights: Native iOS/iPadOS port of Ocarina of Time via the Ship of Harkinian engine
Metal rendering with customizable touch controls, keyboard, and controller support
ROM-free reproducible builds — the compile never reads your ROM
Files-based setup: drop a legally acquired ROM into the app folder, no downloads
Played on physical iPad Pro hardware with save loading and in-place updates
curatorNote: A brand-new native iOS port of a beloved classic that hit the weekly trending list almost immediately, yet sits at about 340 stars. The ROM-free reproducible build discipline is genuinely impressive for a community project.
